t: You're at the Stuart Hall Library, the special collections library and archive of Iniva. It sits in Pimlico, on the campus of Chelsea College of Arts, though it's independent of the college. It's named after Stuart Hall, the Jamaican-born British sociologist and cultural theorist, who lived from 1932 to 1914... correction, to 2014. Hall was a political activist and, alongside Richard Hoggart and Raymond Williams, one of the founding figures of cultural studies, including the school of thought known as the Birmingham School.
